purpose: Teach: 開通/見出す/最優秀/難易/パケット/初版/定数/休止

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究所までの道路開通は朗報だな
lines.en: Ren — the road to the research facility opening is good news.
lines.style: Measured, decisive. Voice carries the weight of someone who sees opportunity. Straightforward delivery, no flourish. The rhythm of someone used to being heard.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。データに新仮説を見出すべく取り組みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll work to find new hypotheses in the data.
lines.style: Earnest and slightly formal. Quiet conviction under the surface. Leans slightly forward — not physically anxious, but mentally engaged. The careful enunciation of someone proving something to himself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: Ren — aim for the best presentation award.
lines.style: Direct, unembellished. A statement of expectation, not a suggestion. Slight pause before the main clause — letting it land. The tone of someone who believes in high standards because they see the person is capable of meeting them.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。難易の高い実験を選んで挑みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll select challenging experiments and take them on.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Slightly faster pace than before — he's already moving into solution mode. No hesitation or doubt in the consonants. Breath support steady, almost soldier-like in its discipline.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、ネットワークのパケット遅延を確認しろ
lines.en: Ren — check the network packet latency.
lines.style: Businesslike, efficient. The shift to a specific technical directive. Voice drops slightly lower — this is immediate work. No negotiation in the delivery, but not unkind. The tone of a manager who trusts the person to understand the weight of the request.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。希少な初版本を文献にあたります
lines.en: Yes. I'll consult rare first editions for my literature review.
lines.style: Respectfully acknowledging the instruction. Slightly more formal register than previous responses. A small lift at the end — showing he's already thinking about the next step. The careful politeness of someone in a junior position who wants to show he's tracking the bigger picture.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文では定数の妥当性を確認しろ
lines.en: Ren — in your paper, verify the validity of the constants.
lines.style: Returning to the teaching tone. Specific, detailed. A small pause before 'constants' — emphasizing precision. The voice of someone who has seen too many papers fail because of overlooked detail. Not harsh, but unsparing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。失敗実験の休止判断も学びます
lines.en: Yes. I'll also learn from judging when to pause failed experiments.
lines.style: Softly earnest, closing the exchange. A slight upward inflection on 'also' — showing he's integrated the broader lesson. Trailing off gently, like someone settling into the work ahead. The gratitude of someone who realizes he's being taught something beyond the immediate task.
